Julia Park: Heads-up — nightly SAST/DAST failed on release/candidate. DAST couldn't fetch fixtures (KMS decrypt=403) and SAST surfaced a high in billing/parse_money.go. Also noticed a policy-gen run earlier that updated IAM templates. @Marco @Dana can we triage?
Marco R.: link to run: https://ci.example.com/runs/101900
scanner-bot: nightly-scan 4456791234: status=FAIL, sast=1 high (billing/parse_money.go), dast=1 medium (fixture fetch), infra=KMS_DECRYPT=403 for principal=fixture-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Dana K.: artifact log: ```rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Caller does not have permission to access cryptoKeys/fixtures-key, principal=fixture-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
Julia Park: was there a policy-gen or infra rollout? policy-bot, did you run anything?
policy-bot: policy-gen 4456780000: auto-deploy of iam templates for project:redwood-prod executed by infra-automation@redwood-tools. Change id CH-2567. Note: generator v2.1.0 applied.
Marco R.: that generator update matches timeline. My worry is the template change dropped key-level bindings when converting to new role schema. I'll run auditlog slice: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.type="cloudkms_key_ring"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=50` and share hits.
Dana K.: SAST file billing/parse_money.go is a real bug — missing currency validation leading to panic when symbol missing. I'll take the fix. No suppression.
Julia Park: ops suggestion to unblock: add a conditional key-level binding for fixture-service with short TTL (2h) and annotate change with CH-2567 link. Prefer key-level binding, not project-level.
ops-oncall: proposed command (dry-run): ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding fixtures-key --keyring=fixtures --location=global --member='serviceAccount:fixture-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-04-18T09:00:00Z'),title=temp_unblock,description=temporary unblock for nightly scans" --project=redwood-prod``` Will hold until audit evidence attached.
Marco R.: auditlog result: found SetIamPolicy by infra-automation@redwood-tools at 2026-04-18T02:05Z (CH-2567). Policy replace omitted previous key binding for fixture-service. Evidence uploaded to CH-2567. Pinging @team-infra to confirm generator regression.
policy-bot: noted. Generator v2.1.0 has a schema migration that prunes unknown key bindings; a bug in migration logic skipped per-key role preservation. Creating follow-up issue POLICY-421.
Julia Park: ok ops, you have go-ahead to apply conditional key binding after attaching CH-2567 evidence link. Dana, can you estimate SAST PR ETA?
Dana K.: PR for parse_money.go up in ~1.5h with unit tests and a SAST regression case. Will add to backport list.
Marco R.: DAST 500s were caused because crawler couldn't download fixtures, so once ops applies binding and we re-run, DAST should clear. Also let's add a CI preflight: `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions fixtures-key --permissions=cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` as a quick smoke. I'll open TOOLS ticket.
ops-oncall: applying conditional binding now with annotation to CH-2567 and a one-line justification. Command executed and logged.
scanner-bot: re-run queued (re-run id: 101901)
scanner-bot: re-run 101901: overall=PASS, sast=PASS(after PR merged), dast=PASS, infra=artifact-fetch=OK
Julia Park: great. Follow-ups: - POLICY-421: infra to fix policy-gen migration to preserve key-level bindings and add unit tests - TOOLS-9001: add kms test-iam-permissions preflight to nightly pipeline - Ops to document conditional binding steps in runbook and ensure TTL is present - Postmortem/summary in INCIDENT-2026-04-18-keybind-regress if infra confirms accidental removal
policy-bot: POLICY-421 created; assigned to infra-tools. Incident stub ready: INCIDENT-2026-04-18-keybind-regress.
Marco R.: I'll draft a short blameless summary and schedule a 30-min sync with infra/tools to harden the generator and add the preflight check.
Dana K.: PR merged and backported. Added SAST harness test to prevent similar regressions.
Julia Park: thanks team. Closing loop: Marco to own follow-up sync; ops to confirm conditional binding auto-expires; infra-tools to propose rollback-safe generator changes. :thumbsup:
